reuse.why: Takes its category set from the existing getMonthActionCategories, reads activity via getSheetValue/sheetForMonth/prevMonth and writes through setBudget inside batchMessages, exactly like the sibling actions.

duplication.why: It repeats the 'skip income unless tracking budget' guard and the expense sign flip that every sibling month action also inlines; no shared helper exists for those, so the repetition follows the tree's pattern rather than copying a block.

placement.why: The action sits in server/budget/actions.ts next to set3MonthAvg and is registered in budget/app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)) like the other month-wide actions.

scope.why: Only the new action, its registration, a test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Short and idiomatic; the inline income guard and sign flip are one more copy to keep consistent if that rule ever changes.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses getMonthActionCategories, setBudget and batchMessages; no existing abstraction is skipped.

disguised_duplication.where: The income guard and sign flip in setLastMonthSpending are written the same way as in setZero/set3MonthAvg, not reshaped (the sign flip is spelled '0 - activity' instead of '*= -1', a cosmetic variant).
